author: Steven_
body:
Banned: Hacking-Kill Aura 
Mod: SnowSX3  
IGN: Steven_
-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=--=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=
So I was banned. Ban: http://gyazo.com/b13931c4448dcc3486cd76a4690ff474

Here's evidence of my capable click speed, and a pick of my files 

Click speed: http://gyazo.com/06fa4f69cdb80dfa7c44f8e4d50e6c5b

Files: http://gyazo.com/d6aa6fb3dd08bf6f531217fa5483679c

I can provide more screenshots if needed for my unban.  But I can't record because of software problems.
-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=--=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=
I believe I should be un-banned because, of course, "I wasn't hacking" 

I will admit, not like this will help, I have hacked before. But never on Avicus, I've always liked Avicus and I didn't want to risk getting banned. I've been a loyal member for over a year, ever sense I started Minecraft. (I have stopped hacking, I thought it was very cheap, and when I did it was only on faction servers.)

(Again) I wish to be un-banned because I'm finally getting back to playing after the reset. The update that made me cri :'(. But I'm good now :D.

So hopefully you take this appeal into consideration. If you need more evidence I can provide more through screenshots.

Sorry for the inconvenience.

Regards,
